summary: Executes one physics step frame for a vehicle: shifts wheel-state history, runs the suspension wheel dynamics solver with a step value a2, processes two batch-iteration helpers over a suspension workspace at this + 1387 dwords, performs a minimum-finding iteration using a2, then copies suspension data to the physics sub-objects. No branches; the full sequence always runs.

operations.description: WheelStateHistoryShift(this) shifts the wheel state history buffers for this vehicle.
SuspensionWheelDynamicsSolver(this, a2) solves wheel suspension dynamics for this vehicle using the step value a2.
sub_56ECF0(this + 1387) is a batch-iteration helper applied to the suspension workspace located at this + 1387 dwords.
sub_56EE40(this + 1387) is a second batch-iteration helper applied to the same suspension workspace.
IterateAndFindMinimumValueFromFunction(a2) performs a minimum-value search via an iteration function using the step value a2.
PhysicsSubObjectFree(this) copies the suspension data into the physics sub-objects.
Invoked per-frame as the core physics step by VehiclePhysicsIntegrationStep (0x00441650).
